# Message Queues

## Bottom Line

Use Redis Streams: at our volume it is the cheapest queue to run, and the job runner already depends on Redis.

## Findings

- Redis Streams handled 50,000 jobs a minute on one small instance in our test.
- A managed RabbitMQ cluster cost about $400 a month.
- Kafka is more than the job runner needs at this volume.
